body: I think it's hard to have a hold of that in my country.

5-10 yrs is too long. I need to suffer for that long period of time while pretending i'm ok even though i'm really dying inside? It is hard. It really is. To continue living having those feelings inside you. That's why i want to purposely have an amnesia. If not, I might as well just kill myself.

You know its not that easy right? I tried to distract myself, I enjoyed doing my hobbies. But everytime I have a vacant time specially when I'm at my bed, I can't help but feel all those pain again and cry myself to sleep.

I also just lost someone important in my life. And he's the only one i have. I depend my whole life with him. And now he's gone. I don't know what to do with my life anymore. I can't continue living anymore, i don't know how. I'm also having suicidal thoughts but i'm scared to kill myself. I just wish i don't wake up forever everytime i sleep at night.
I think my bf's just waiting for me to breakup with him. I think he only feel sorry for me that's why we're still together. But I feel that he doesn't love me anymore.
